support_install_faq_a1: Please ensure the installation site has basic power, water supply/drainage, and ventilation. Each unit is fully tested and calibrated before shipment — ready to use upon arrival. Our installation service mainly helps you plan placement and complete connections. support_install_faq_a5: Installation fees cover engineer travel and standard parts. We provide a free quote first — no work begins until you approve. No hidden charges.
support_install_faq_a6: A single unit installation typically takes just a few hours with minimal business impact. For full production line installations, we schedule in advance and try to work during non-business hours to minimize disruption.
